svg.title: A Trajectory Loses Its Beginning
svg.desc: The native Lorenz renderer colors short trajectory chunks by progression. A cyan-range deletion removes early-colored chunks; selected survivors are discretized into polygons and rebuilt as short normal-vector combs. Three colors then distinguish inherited structures across a slight affine skew, leaving a deliberately incomplete phase-space history.
